problem: The answer uses 0.36 fck for the flange overhang as well as the web: C = 0.36 fck[bw xu + (bf − bw) Df]. The standard stress block (IS 456 style, as used in prestressed flanged design) uses 0.36 fck bw xu for the web but 0.45 fck (bf − bw) yf for the flange overhang, so the quiz number 0.36 fck × 132,000 N is not the correct compression force.
fix: C = 0.36 fck bw xu + 0.45 fck (bf − bw) Df = 0.36 fck (300 × 200) + 0.45 fck (600 × 120) = (21,600 + 32,400) fck = 54,000 fck N. Also state this two-term form in Section 2 where it says 'add the web and flange overhang terms'.
